page_title: LAZ 0-0 CRE | Lazio v Cremonese 20/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.

90+7' The free kick from the edge of the box is taken by Danilo Cataldi (Lazio), who fires in a direct effort inches over the crossbar. What a chance! The ball goes out of play and Cremonese will have a goal kick.
90+6' Lazio earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
90+4' NO PENALTY after a VAR review! The Lazio players are visibly unhappy with the call.
90+4' Referee Luca Pairetto makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Lazio. Let’s see what happens!
90+4' Federico Ceccherini (Cremonese) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
90+2' Mario Gila (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Luca Pairetto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Reda Belahyane (Lazio) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
88' Here is a change. Tommaso Barbieri is going off and Davide Nicola gives the last tactical orders to Romano Floriani (Cremonese).
85' The free kick from close range, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
84' Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) bends a great shot in from the edge of the box, but Ivan Provedel makes a smart save to deny him.
82' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Manuel Lazzari (Lazio) comes onto the pitch so that Luca Pellegrini can be given a rest.
81' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Luca Pairetto had an easy-decision to make.
80' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) is booked.

79' A neat pass is well received by Adam Marusic (Lazio), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
77' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Alessio Romagnoli (Lazio) for his blatant foul.
76' Davide Nicola has decided to substitute Dennis Johnsen and he is replaced by Alessio Zerbin (Cremonese).
76' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Antonio Sanabria (Cremonese) will replace Federico Bonazzoli.

75' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Ivan Provedel tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
74' Emil Audero (Cremonese) is able to continue to play.
73' Emil Audero (Cremonese) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
72' The foul by Taty Castellanos (Lazio) was seen by Luca Pairetto who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.
70' A pass lands at the feet of Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
69' Davide Nicola has decided to make a change. Federico Ceccherini (Cremonese) replaces Francesco Folino.
69' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Alberto Grassi as he is replaced by Jari Vandeputte (Cremonese).
68' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) was quite harsh and Luca Pairetto didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.

66' Ambitious effort from Tijjani Noslin (Lazio). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
63' That's the end of the game for Matias Vecino, who is replaced by Reda Belahyane (Lazio).
63' Maurizio Sarri prepares a substitution. Pedro is replaced by Tijjani Noslin (Lazio).
63' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.
62' Some great controlled play and passing from Lazio. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
59' Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack.

58' Pedro (Lazio) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
58' A cross into the box from Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is cleared.
56' Cremonese seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
53' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Luca Pairetto blows for a foul.

52' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
50' Taty Castellanos (Lazio) peeled away from his marker and got on the end of the resulting corner, but he sends his header straight at the goalkeeper.
50' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Lazio.
49' One of the Lazio players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
48' The Lazio players are exchanging some short passes.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+2' The match has reached half-time.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
43' Alberto Grassi (Cremonese) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
41' Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
40' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Lazio.
38' Pedro (Lazio) has tested the patience of referee Luca Pairetto and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
37' Cremonese enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
34' A pass from Luca Pellegrini (Lazio) is intercepted by Emil Audero and the move breaks down.
32' Lazio failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

32' Pedro (Lazio) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Lazio are awarded a corner kick.

31' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cremonese.
31' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
28' Lazio couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Emil Audero (Cremonese) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
27' The players claim that Jamie Vardy (Cremonese) handled the ball and it seems they are right. That's a free kick to Lazio.
27' Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) swings in the corner, but it's comfortably cleared away.
26' Great teamplay by Lazio as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
23' The ball is cleared after Tommaso Barbieri (Cremonese) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
20' A cross from Adam Marusic (Lazio) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

18' Cremonese are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
15' Francesco Folino (Cremonese) gives away a foul during an attacking move and the referee blows his whistle.
14' Cremonese are showcasing great team work and neat passing moves.
11' Federico Baschirotto (Cremonese) commits a foul during an attacking move.
10' Matias Vecino (Lazio) trips an opposition player and Luca Pairetto signals a foul.
9' Giuseppe Pezzella (Cremonese) picks up a long through ball, but Ivan Provedel deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.

6' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies just over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Lazio will have a goal kick.
5' Federico Bonazzoli (Cremonese) strikes the ball towards goal from distance, but it goes over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
5' The Lazio players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
2' Cremonese couldn't find the way to score from a mid-range free kick as Ivan Provedel (Lazio) leaped high and intercepted the cross.
2' Matteo Cancellieri (Lazio) makes a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. Cremonese get a free kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
Cremonese will kick-off.
Luca Pairetto will officiate today.
